prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic winter fashion portrait in a snowy landscape.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with fair skin, long straight hair, oversized white faux-fur ushanka, and soft engaging smile, wearing a matte black opaque long-sleeve top and full-length trousers or leggings.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter rear-facing turn with head looking back over the shoulder, relaxed balanced posture, snow-covered evergreens, modern timber cabin with glass windows, thick textured snow, and upper-body/three-quarter framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffused winter daylight reflected by snow, cool soft shadows, clean fur highlights, crisp cold daytime atmosphere, subtle shallow background blur.
prompt.technical_specs: Digital SLR or mirrorless look, 85mm prime, f/2.8–f/4, natural proportions, realistic hair, fur, snow, and fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic winter fashion portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with fair skin and long straight hair wearing an oversized fluffy white faux-fur ushanka with ear flaps down. She wears a matte black opaque long-sleeve top and full-length trousers or leggings. Frame her in a relaxed three-quarter rear-facing turn with her head looking back over the shoulder and a soft engaging smile, without body-part emphasis or arching. Snow-covered evergreen trees and a modern wooden cabin with large reflective glass windows fill the background; thick uneven snow covers the ground. Use diffused winter daylight, snow-reflected fill, cool soft shadows, crisp fur highlights, 85mm lens, f/2.8–f/4, and subtle background blur.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bodysuit, transparent fabric, rear emphasis, glute focus, arched back, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, ushanka, blonde hair, snow, cabin, black-white palette, and head-turn composition; replace bodysuit with opaque full-coverage winter clothing. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Replaced tight bodysuit, rear/glute emphasis, and arched posture with opaque full-coverage winter clothing and a relaxed three-quarter turn.
